data.headline: Intuit’s AI-Driven Expert Platform Redefines Tax Filing with ‘Done-For-You’ Experiences

(Nasdaq: INTU), the global financial technology platform that makes Intuit TurboTax, Credit Karma, QuickBooks, and Mailchimp, today announced its tax platform offerings for personal and small business filers. New innovations and seamless integrations across Intuit’s AI-driven expert platform deliver an accurate and personalized "done-for-you" tax filing experience with speed, guaranteeing maximum refunds faster.
